title: Fix Generation + Final Integration

Final build verification: npm install + cargo tauri build clean
bob_reasoning: Fix generation for Critical patterns is templated - each pattern ID maps to a fix template function that takes the finding's snippet and returns refactored Kotlin/Java code. The templates are designed to be minimal - they replace only the anti-pattern code, not the surrounding context. The standalone report.html injects scan data via a <script id='scan-data' type='application/json'> tag which the report's JavaScript reads on load - this allows the report to be saved as a static file and opened in any browser without the Tauri shell.
